gates.name: Environment detected
gates.description: Choose Buck versus Cargo and Git versus Sapling before build, test, or source-control commands.

gates.name: Architecture fit checked
gates.description: Identify the affected Pyrefly area before editing shared type-checker behavior.

gates.name: Plan before broad change
gates.description: Require a plan for broad, cross-phase, or risky changes.

gates.name: Regression considered
gates.description: Add or update a targeted test for behavior changes, or explain why no test is appropriate.

gates.name: Verify before completion
gates.description: Do not claim completion without verification evidence or a clear explanation of why verification could not run.

gates.name: Format and lint before handoff
gates.description: Run the repository formatting/linting driver before handing code off.

gates.name: Record process change
gates.description: Record notable harness or workflow changes after implementation.

rules.name: Architecture Fit
rules.description: Place changes in the matching Pyrefly architecture phase or product area.

rules.name: Correctness Over Fallbacks
rules.description: Unreachable type-checker states must panic with a clear invariant instead of silently degrading.

rules.name: Minimal Rust
rules.description: Prefer simple local changes and avoid single-use helpers unless they clarify real invariants.

rules.name: Type Representation Discipline
rules.description: Prefer existing pyrefly_types helpers before manually constructing or destructuring Type values.

rules.name: Semantic Extraction
rules.description: Extract semantic facts early instead of passing parsed Expr nodes through unrelated layers.

rules.name: Build and VCS Discipline
rules.description: Detect Buck/Cargo and Sapling/Git before running commands.

rules.name: Testing Standards
rules.description: Use targeted regression tests and the project formatting/linting driver before handoff.

skills.name: Pyrefly Orientation
skills.description: Identify the affected Pyrefly architecture phase and checkout environment before implementation.

skills.name: Regression Planning
skills.description: Choose the smallest code path and regression test that prove the intended type-checker or LSP behavior.

skills.name: Pyrefly Implementation
skills.description: Implement minimal Rust changes using existing helpers and explicit invariants.

skills.name: Pyrefly Verification
skills.description: Run targeted Cargo or Buck tests and the repository formatting/linting driver.

skills.name: Pyrefly Review Prep
skills.description: Prepare a semantics-focused summary with risk and verification evidence.

skills.name: Process Record
skills.description: Record durable harness or workflow changes without logging routine implementation noise.

stack.name: Rust Python type checker and LSP
stack.description: Pyrefly is a Rust workspace for Python type checking and language-server behavior, with Python fixtures and tooling.

workflows.name: Record
exitCriteria: Durable process changes recorded when applicable
